portInfo.description: A stunning archipelago in northern Norway known for dramatic mountains, fishing villages, and the midnight sun.

climate.description: Subarctic climate with mild winters due to Gulf Stream influence

politics.visaRequirements: Entry and visa rules depend on nationality. Many visitors use Schengen short-stay rules, but requirements change—confirm with official government sources and your cruise line before travel.
politics.entryRequirements: Carry a valid passport (or a national ID where your cruise line and destination authorities accept it). Cruise transit formalities can differ from a normal airport entry—follow your ship’s document list.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Check the daily programme for your berth and allow extra time on turnaround or tender days.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Lofotr Viking Museum, Borg — listed from Leknes on Visit Lofoten Cruise — ~90–150 min on site; transfer not surveyed.
Scenic island coach / fishing-village viewpoints — line excursions; independent self-drive timing not verified.
Reine / Hamnøy photo stops — only with confirmed return; Reine also has its own catalog slug.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the tender or quay area and one harbour village; keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Pick one island highlight or museum if transfer is confirmed—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: Cross-island or Lofotr outings need confirmed coaches or ship excursions and a full-day window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Confirm Leknes alongside vs tender and whether your ticket is actually Svolvær before planning.
